title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Mize fell apart in the sixth tonight
Dominant before that, though
My game got rained out so I got home just in time to see it happen on tv Was Alberto there?
Yep
Looked like he left early, though, which I'm not sure if he just left
Chadd and Pleis, too
Don’t think there’s much else on either of those clubs. I’d have to assume they’re staying/flying out of Atlanta so probably jumped out
Did you meet Justin Henry? Area scout there?
Yeah but it was before Mize was done
Yeah randomly lol
I was looking for scouts opinions and he was the first guy I talked to lol
Ha! Perfect. Good dude, played at ole miss and up to at least 2A, can remember if he ever got to 3A.
Al likes to watch a lot of pitcher from the side for a long time, to see the arm work. May have just been down line hiding
What did you think of mize stuff? Could you see the splitter/cutter movement?
Yep I saw him watch that way in the fourth inning
He was nasty early
But then he got too cutter happy
Wasn't throwing his fastball much late

Got ya Another thing to contend with college pitching, the pitches get called from the dugout and coaches tend to call in a way that, uh, most pro scouts/coaches don’t agree with It is a weird wrinkle with him how little he uses the fastball. Will need to lean on fastball much more heavily at the next level
That splitter is gross when it’s right though!
Cutter was actually his best pitch for me @ florida
I guess he calls his own pitches
He looked the part, though
You think they're wavering at all?
No doubt That sounds right, either way he’s gonna be forced to pitch off the fastball after he signs
https://amp.detroitnews.com/amp/34995541

No I don’t think a couple weeks of fair starts would get them off of him, we all know the stuff can be very, very good. But we’re not going to stop scouting, and I know Al has been out seeing as much as possible. I don’t get any inside dope but one thing I can promise you, no matter who the “front runner” has looked like all year we’ve all been treating that deal like a wiiide open competition.
Yep, he was at GT seeing Bart yesterday
I’ve been dying them to tell me to get off this guy or that guy, but the directive all along has been were on everybody and can’t give up on anyone
I hear he’s been going good lately too...and I know we’d love to add some legit bats
Yeah I read that this morning...where the hell is Henning getting his dope for those articles anyway!? He writes them like he’s got a weekly conference call with Scott Pleis!
LOL
I know
When he first started them James Orr and I spent 20 minutes on the phone with each other going “what the fuck, Who’s giving him this shit”!!!
I don't think anyone is. I think it's just Lynn being Lynn
He stuck his foot in his mouth with a Reynaldo Rivera tweet at some point
The first couple ones were fairly spot on with the big picture of guys but accuracy hasn’t been as good, predictably, down the stretch
Don’t even get me started on that bullshit

Fucking kid is 19 years old coming off the longest season of his life. He’s got as much impact potential as anyone in Baseball. I’ve seen him do shit nobody else on the planet do, except for prince fielder. Calling for people to be fired. FOH
I know
That's Lynn lol
Great guy but he can go off his rocker

Don’t get me wrong, I don’t hate the guy for it, it just seemed so odd to die on that hill And I think he’s a pretty talented scribe. I enjoy reading most of his stuff. It can be grandiose, but I don’t mind that. But that tweet/thread, I mean, WTF?
Grandiose lol
That's a Lynn word

Rivera is going to strike out a shit ton but he might hit 30 homers. Maybe more. And he saved us money to make other picks Signed my high school catcher Sam McMillan with that money. And Sam is hitting over .400 in extended right now.
Lol yeah it is
I was raised by an attorney I have a pretty fucked up vocabulary
Liked “I was raised by an attorney I have a pretty fucked up vocabulary”
